arxiv-1903-10884.title: Polarimetric Neutron Tomography of Magnetic Fields: Uniqueness of Solution and Reconstruction
arxiv-1903-10884.creator: Søren Schmidt
arxiv-1903-10884.description: Abstract We consider the problem of determination of a magnetic field from three dimensional polarimetric neutron tomography data. We see that this is an example of a non-Abelian ray transform and that the problem has a globally unique solution for smooth magnetic fields with compact support, and a locally unique solution for less smooth fields.

arxiv-2102-03718.title: An Analysis of Frame-skipping in Reinforcement Learning Thanks: Equal contribution
arxiv-2102-03718.creator: Shivaram Kalyanakrishnan, Siddharth Aravindan *, Vishwajeet Bagdawat *, Varun Bhatt *, Harshith Goka *, Archit Gupta *, Kalpesh Krishna *, Vihari Piratla *
arxiv-2102-03718.description: Abstract . In the practice of sequential decision making, agents are often designed to sense state at regular intervals of d d time steps, d > 1 d>1 , ignoring state information in between sensing steps. While it is clear that this practice can reduce sensing and compute costs, recent results indicate a further benefit.

arxiv-2102-06429.title: Bootstrapping Large-Scale Fine-Grained Contextual Advertising Classifier from Wikipedia
arxiv-2102-06429.creator: Yiping Jin, Vishakha Kadam, Dittaya Wanvarie
arxiv-2102-06429.description: Abstract Contextual advertising provides advertisers with the opportunity to target the context which is most relevant to their ads. The large variety of potential topics makes it very challenging to collect training documents to build a supervised classification model or compose expert-written rules in a rule-based classification system.

arxiv-2103-07618.title: Electronic statistics-on-demand: bunching, anti-bunching, positive and negative correlations in a molecular spin-valve
arxiv-2103-07618.creator: Nicholas S. Davis, Samuel L. Rudge, Daniel S. Kosov
arxiv-2103-07618.description: Abstract One of the long-standing goals of quantum transport is to use the noise, rather than the average current, for information processing. However, achieving this requires on-demand control of quantum fluctuations in the electric current. In this paper, we demonstrate theoretically that transport through a molecular spin-valve provides access to many different statistics of electron tunneling events.

arxiv-2111-09600.title: Limits on non-canonical heating and turbulence in the intergalactic medium from the low redshift Lyman- α \alpha forest 2022 Limits on non-canonical heating and turbulence in the intergalactic medium from the low redshift Lyman- α \alpha forest – C
arxiv-2111-09600.creator: James S. Bolton, Prakash Gaikwad, Martin G. Haehnelt, Tae-Sun Kim, Fahad Nasir, Ewald Puchwein, Matteo Viel & Bart P. Wakker
arxiv-2111-09600.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by James S. Bolton, Prakash Gaikwad, Martin G. Haehnelt, Tae-Sun Kim, Fahad Nasir, Ewald Puchwein, Matteo Viel & Bart P. Wakker. We examine the column density distribution function (CDDF) and Doppler parameter distribution from hydrodynamical simulations and Cosmic Origins Spectrograph (COS) observations of the Ly α \alpha forest at redshift 0 ≤ z ≤ 0.2 0\leq z\leq 0.2 .

arxiv-2201-12406.title: Syfer : Neural Obfuscation for Private Data Release
arxiv-2201-12406.creator: Adam Yala, Victor Quach, Homa Esfahanizadeh, Rafael G. L. D’Oliveira, Ken R. Duffy, Muriel Médard, Tommi S. Jaakkola, Regina Barzilay
arxiv-2201-12406.description: Abstract Balancing privacy and predictive utility remains a central challenge for machine learning in healthcare. In this paper, we develop Syfer , a neural obfuscation method to protect against re-identification attacks. Syfer composes trained layers with random neural networks to encode the original data (e.g. X-rays) while maintaining the ability to predict diagnoses from the encoded data.

arxiv-2306-06971.title: Expanding the inventory of spectral lines used to trace atmospheric escape in exoplanets
arxiv-2306-06971.creator: D.C. Linssen, A. Oklopčić
arxiv-2306-06971.description: Abstract Escaping exoplanet atmospheres have been observed as deep transit signatures in a few specific spectral lines. Detections have been made in the hydrogen Ly- α \alpha line, the metastable helium line at 10830 Å and some UV lines of metallic species.

arxiv-2309-00875.title: A hidden Markov model for statistical arbitrage in international crude oil futures markets Thanks: JEL classification . C51, C58, G11, G15. Financial support from the University of Padova (research programme STARS StG PRISMA - “Probabilistic Methods for Information in Security Markets”) is gratefull
arxiv-2309-00875.creator: Viviana Fanelli, Claudio Fontana, Francesco Rotondi
arxiv-2309-00875.description: Abstract . We study statistical arbitrage strategies in international crude oil futures markets. We analyse strategies that extend classical pairs trading strategies, considering two benchmark crude oil futures (Brent and WTI) together with the recently introduced Shanghai crude oil futures.

arxiv-2402-18687.title: Autoresonant Removal of Fusion Products in Mirror Machines
arxiv-2402-18687.creator: Eli Gudinetsky, Tal Miller, Ilan Be’ery, Ido Barth
arxiv-2402-18687.description: Abstract Magnetic confinement fusion reactors produce fusion byproduct particles that must be removed for efficient operation. It is suggested to use autoresonance (a continuous phase-locking between anharmonic motion and a chirped drive) to remove the fusion products from a magnetic mirror, the simplest magnetic confinement configuration. An analogy to the driven pendulum is established via the guiding center approximation.

arxiv-2406-16564.title: FASTC: A Fast Attentional Framework for Semantic Traversability Classification Using Point Cloud
arxiv-2406-16564.creator: Yirui Chen, Pengjin Wei, Zhenhuan Liu, Bingchao Wang, Jie Yang, Wei Liu
arxiv-2406-16564.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yirui Chen, Pengjin Wei, Zhenhuan Liu, Bingchao Wang, Jie Yang, Wei Liu. Producing traversability maps and understanding the surroundings are crucial prerequisites for autonomous navigation. In this paper, we address the problem of traversability assessment using point clouds. We propose a novel pillar feature extraction module that utilizes PointNet to capture features from point clouds organized in vertical volume and a 2D encoder-decoder structure to conduct traversability classification instead of the widely used 3D convolutions.

arxiv-2408-11651.title: Boolean basis, formula size, and number of modal operators
arxiv-2408-11651.creator: Christoph Berkholz \rsuper * ORCID:0000-0002-3554-517X, Dietrich Kuske, Christian Schwarz ORCID:0009-0002-6475-4779
arxiv-2408-11651.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Christoph Berkholz \rsuper * ORCID:0000-0002-3554-517X, Dietrich Kuske, Christian Schwarz ORCID:0009-0002-6475-4779. Is it possible to write significantly smaller formulae when using Boolean operators other than those of the De Morgan basis (and, or, not, and the constants)? For propositional logic, a negative answer was given by Pratt: formulae over one set of operators can always be translated into an equivalent formula over any other complete set of operators with only polynomial increase in size.

arxiv-2410-01172.title: Proof-of-principle experimental demonstration of quantum secure imaging based on quantum key distribution
arxiv-2410-01172.creator: Yi-Bo Zhao 1,2 , Wan-Li Zhang 1,2 , Dong Wang 1,2 , Xiao-Tian Song 1,2 , Liang-Jiang Zhou 1,2,3, , and Chi-Biao Ding 1,2,3
arxiv-2410-01172.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yi-Bo Zhao 1,2 , Wan-Li Zhang 1,2 , Dong Wang 1,2 , Xiao-Tian Song 1,2 , Liang-Jiang Zhou 1,2,3, , and Chi-Biao Ding 1,2,3. We present a quantum secure imaging (QSI) scheme based on the phase encoding and weak + + vacuum decoy-state BB84 protocol of quantum key distribution (QKD).

arxiv-2509-10418.title: Witt Groups and Bulk-Boundary Correspondence for Stabilizer States
arxiv-2509-10418.creator: Błażej Ruba, Bowen Yang
arxiv-2509-10418.description: Abstract We establish a bulk–boundary correspondence for translation-invariant stabilizer states in arbitrary spatial dimension, formulated in the framework of modules over Laurent polynomial rings. To each stabilizer state restricted to half-space geometry we associate a boundary operator module. Boundary operator modules provide examples of quasi-symplectic modules, which are objects of independent mathematical interest.

arxiv-2509-22006.title: Isoenergetic description of induced fission pathways within energy-density functional theory
arxiv-2509-22006.creator: Alan A. Dzhioev, N. V. Antonenko
arxiv-2509-22006.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alan A. Dzhioev, N. V. Antonenko. A thermodynamically consistent description of induced fission pathways in the superheavy nucleus 296 Lv is presented within the framework of nuclear energy-density functional theory. Using self-consistent finite-temperature Hartree-Fock-Bogoliubov calculations with the Skyrme-type energy-density functional SkM ∗ , we derive and compare effective potentials corresponding to different thermodynamic processes—isothermal ( T = const T=\text{const} ), isentropic ( S = const S=\text{const} ), and isoenergetic ( E = const E=\text{const} )—as functions of quadrupole deformation and excitation energy.

arxiv-2601-02429.title: Thrust Regulation in a Solid Fuel Ramjet using Dynamic Mode Adaptive Control
arxiv-2601-02429.creator: Parham Oveissi, Gohar T. Khokhar, Kyle Hanquist, Ankit Goel
arxiv-2601-02429.description: Abstract This paper presents the application of a novel data-driven adaptive control technique, called dynamic mode adaptive control (DMAC), for regulating thrust in a solid fuel ramjet (SFRJ). A high-fidelity computational model incorporating compressible flow theory and equilibrium chemistry is used to simulate the combustion dynamics.

arxiv-2601-07718.title: Hiking in the Wild: A Scalable Perceptive Parkour Framework for Humanoids
arxiv-2601-07718.creator: Shaoting Zhu, Ziwen Zhuang, Mengjie Zhao, Kun-Ying Lee, Hang Zhao
arxiv-2601-07718.description: Abstract Achieving robust humanoid hiking in complex, unstructured environments requires transitioning from reactive proprioception to proactive perception. However, integrating exteroception remains a significant challenge: mapping-based methods suffer from state estimation drift; for instance, LiDAR-based methods do not handle torso jitter well.

pmc-10786210.title: An Overview of the Mechanism behind Excessive Volume of Pericardial Fat in Heart Failure
pmc-10786210.creator: Sandeep Karna, Ki-Woon Kang
pmc-10786210.description: Heart failure (HF) is a clinical syndrome characterized by myocardial dysfunction leading to inefficient blood filling or ejection. Regardless of the etiology, various mechanisms, including adipokine hypersecretion, proinflammatory cytokines, stem cell proliferation, oxidative stress, hyperglycemic toxicity, and autonomic nervous system dysregulation in the pericardial fat (PCF), contribute to the development of HF.

pmc-11406328.title: A ratiometric fluorescent electrospun film with high amine sensitivity and stability for visual monitoring of livestock meat freshness
pmc-11406328.creator: Xiaodong Zhai, Yuhong Xue, Wenjun Song, Yue Sun, Tingting Shen, Xinai Zhang, Yanxiao Li, Fuyuan Ding, Di Zhang, Chenguang Zhou, Muhammad Arslan, Haroon E. Tahir, Zhihua Li, Jiyong Shi, Xiaowei Huang, Xiaobo Zou
pmc-11406328.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Ratiometric fluorescent films with high amine sensitivity and stability were developed to monitor the freshness of beef and pork. Fluorescein isothiocyanate (FITC) and red carbon quantum dots (R-CQD) were used as the amine-responsive indicator and internal reference, respectively. The electrospun films prepared by immobilizing FITC and R-CQD complex (F-R) into polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) under 35 %, 55 % and 75 % of relative humidity (RH) were named F-R@PVDF-1, F-R@PVDF-2 and F-R@PVDF-3, respectively.

pmc-11429482.title: Effects of Different Processed Diets on Growth Performance, Blood Parameters, Hair Quality and Fecal Microbiota in Ragdoll Cats
pmc-11429482.creator: Peng Wang, Xin Tian, Jie Feng
pmc-11429482.description: Simple SummaryThe dietary preferences for pet cats have been a topic of debate, with extruded dry food, cooked meat, and raw meat being the primary contenders. This study aimed to compare the effects of these three diets on growth performance, blood parameters, fecal scores, and fecal microbiota composition in purebred Ragdoll cats (n = 5/group).

pmc-13273122.title: Association between secondhand smoke exposure and ocular microbiome changes in children
pmc-13273122.creator: Qihang Sun, Xiangtian Ling, Yuzhou Zhang, Charlene C. Yim, Yu Peng, Yating Yang, Hei-Nga Chan, Xiujuan Zhang, Ka Wai Kam, Wai Kit Chu, Patrick Ip, Alvin L. Young, Stephen Kwok-Wing Tsui, Clement C. Tham, Chi Pui Pang, Li Jia Chen, Jason C. Yam
pmc-13273122.description: Highlights•Secondhand smoke (SHS) exposure significantly alters the ocular surface microbiome (OSM) in children aged 3–18 years.•Microbial diversity is significantly reduced on ocular surface in SHS-exposed children.•Beneficial commensal taxa are depleted in SHS-exposed children.•Environmental stress-related metabolic pathways and immune-related pathways are significantly altered in SHS-exposed children.

pmc-13346147.creator: Neha Choudhari, H. S. Anirudh Srinivas, Praneeth Sai Tadepalli, Rounak Roy, Souvik Dey
pmc-13346147.description: BackgroundN6-methyladenosine profiles of mRNA transcripts regulate their translocation from the nucleus to the cytosol, stability, and translational efficiency; hence, they have been implicated in gene expression and disease progression. pmc-13679810.title: Non-traumatic acute mediastinitis secondary to acute phlegmonous esophagitis: a rare case report
pmc-13679810.creator: Meron H Biza, Eyerusalem K Degife, Selamawit Z Tadesse, Chernet T Mengistie, Ephrem M Atsbha, Biruk T Mengistie
pmc-13679810.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Acute mediastinitis secondary to acute phlegmonous esophagitis (APE) is an exceptionally rare, life-threatening condition with high morbidity. We report a 75-year-old diabetic female with recent severe pneumonia who presented with pleuritic chest pain, dyspnea, and elevated inflammatory markers. Computed tomography pulmonary angiography excluded embolism but revealed diffuse long-segment esophageal wall thickening with mediastinal fat stranding, aortic encasement, and pleural effusion, features consistent with APE and secondary non-traumatic mediastinitis without overt perforation.
